name: Spring Boot
certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer (1Z0-830)

beginner.summary: For Java developers new to Spring. Covers creating Spring Boot projects, dependency injection, configuration, REST controllers, validation, Spring Data JPA, migrations, transactions, testing, logging, Actuator, security, calling other services, API documentation, scheduled work and running the service in Docker.
prerequisites: Writes core Java confidently: classes, interfaces, collections, exceptions and lambdas
Has used Maven or Gradle to build a project
outcomes: Build REST APIs with Spring Boot backed by a relational database
Configure, validate, secure and document a service
Write unit and slice tests for Spring components
Package a service and run it in Docker

days.topic: Spring Boot Setup and Project Structure
subtopics: What Spring Boot adds on top of the Spring Framework
Creating a project with Spring Initializr
Choosing starters: web, data JPA, validation, actuator
Maven and Gradle build files for Spring Boot
Running the application from the IDE and the command line
Embedded Tomcat and the default port
days.lab_task: Generate a Spring Boot project with the web, validation and actuator starters, organise packages by feature, change the server port in application.yml and run it from the IDE and with the Maven wrapper.
days.deliverable: Project in Git with a README explaining how to run it
checks: Application starts on the configured port
Packages grouped by feature, not by layer
objectives: Understand starters and the main class

days.topic: Dependency Injection and Spring Beans
subtopics: Inversion of control and the application context
Constructor injection and why it is preferred
days.lab_task: Build a notification module with an interface and two implementations (email and SMS), inject the right one with @Qualifier, create a clock bean in a @Configuration class and replace it in a test.
days.deliverable: Notification module and a test that swaps the clock bean
checks: Context loads with no ambiguous bean errors
Fixed clock is used in the test

days.topic: Configuration Properties and Profiles
subtopics: Profiles for dev, test and prod
Keeping secrets out of the repository
Inspecting configuration with the env endpoint
days.lab_task: Move the notification settings into a validated @ConfigurationProperties record, create dev and prod profiles, override a value with an environment variable and confirm the result through Actuator.
days.deliverable: Configuration classes, profile files and a note on the override order
checks: Startup fails with a clear binding error

days.topic: Building a First REST Controller
subtopics: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE handlers
Request and response bodies with records
Testing endpoints with Postman and curl
days.lab_task: Build a book catalogue API with in-memory storage supporting create, read, update, delete and search by author, returning correct status codes and a Location header on create.
days.deliverable: Controller code and a Postman collection

days.topic: Request Validation and Error Responses
subtopics: Mapping domain exceptions to status codes
Not leaking stack traces to clients
days.lab_task: Add validation to the book API (required title, valid ISBN with a custom validator, positive price), return Problem Details for validation and not-found errors, and confirm no stack traces reach the client.
days.deliverable: Validation rules, error handler and sample error responses
checks: POST a book with an invalid ISBN
400 with the field error in Problem Details
Generic 500 message without a stack trace
Each domain exception mapped to one status

days.topic: Data Access with Spring Data JPA Repositories
subtopics: The persistence context in simple terms
Running PostgreSQL in Docker for development
days.lab_task: Replace in-memory storage with PostgreSQL, map the book entity, add derived queries for author and price range and a JPQL query for books published after a date, and log the SQL Hibernate runs.
days.deliverable: Entity, repository and SQL log extract
checks: Correct books and one SQL query in the log
Each repository method has a test or manual check recorded

days.topic: Entity Relationships and Queries
days.lab_task: Add authors and categories to the catalogue (author has many books, books have many categories), return author pages with a projection and load an author with books using a fetch join.
days.deliverable: Entity mappings, queries and API responses
checks: One query in the SQL log
No infinite recursion in the JSON
Delete a book from an author

days.topic: Database Migrations with Flyway
subtopics: Why not to use ddl-auto in production
Rolling forward instead of rolling back
days.lab_task: Turn off ddl-auto, write Flyway migrations for the current schema, add a migration that introduces a published flag with a default, and set ddl-auto to validate.
days.deliverable: Migration scripts and the flyway_schema_history table output
checks: Change an applied script and restart

days.topic: Service Layer, Transactions and DTOs
subtopics: Mapping with MapStruct or by hand
Keeping entities out of the API
days.lab_task: Add a service that borrows a book (marks it unavailable and records a loan) in one transaction, prove it rolls back when the loan insert fails and expose only DTOs from the controller.
days.deliverable: Service, DTOs and a rollback test
checks: Force the loan insert to fail
Book stays available after the failure
Call a @Transactional method from the same class
No entity types in requests or responses

days.topic: Paging, Sorting and Filtering APIs
days.lab_task: Add paged, sorted search to the catalogue with optional author, category and price filters using Specifications, cap the page size at 100 and add an index for the most common filter.
days.deliverable: Search endpoint, specification code and EXPLAIN output
checks: Run EXPLAIN on the common filter

days.topic: Testing Spring Boot Applications
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the loan service, @WebMvcTest tests for the book controller including validation errors and @DataJpaTest tests for the custom queries.
days.deliverable: Test suite and coverage report
checks: Review coverage of the loan service

days.topic: Logging and Debugging in Spring Boot
subtopics: Debugging with breakpoints in the IDE
days.lab_task: Switch to structured JSON logs, add a filter that sets a correlation ID on every request, change a package log level through Actuator and diagnose a deliberately broken bean from the startup report.
days.deliverable: Logging configuration, filter and diagnosis notes
checks: Each log line has its request's correlation ID
DEBUG lines appear without a restart
Cause identified from the startup report

days.topic: Actuator Health and Metrics
subtopics: The info endpoint and build information
days.lab_task: Expose health, info and metrics, add a custom health indicator for an external dependency, add a counter for loans created and a timer around the search, and restrict all endpoints except health.
days.deliverable: Actuator configuration and sample endpoint output
checks: Health shows DOWN for that indicator

days.topic: Securing APIs with Spring Security
subtopics: What Spring Security adds by default
CSRF and when to disable it for APIs
days.lab_task: Secure the catalogue so anyone can read, members can borrow and admins can create or delete books, store users in the database with BCrypt hashes and test each role.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, user table and test results
checks: Delete a book as a member

days.topic: Calling Other Services with RestClient
days.lab_task: Call an external ISBN lookup service to fill in book details through a declarative HTTP interface, with timeouts, error mapping and a retry, and test it against WireMock.
days.deliverable: Client interface, configuration and WireMock tests
checks: Mapped to a clear domain error
objectives: Test clients without the real service

days.topic: API Documentation with springdoc OpenAPI
subtopics: Keeping docs in sync with code
days.lab_task: Add springdoc, describe all catalogue operations including error responses and the security scheme, and generate a TypeScript client from the spec to prove it is usable.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI spec, Swagger UI screenshot and generated client

days.topic: File Uploads, Static Content and CORS
days.lab_task: Add book cover uploads limited to 2 MB JPEG or PNG, store them on disk with a generated name, stream them back on download and allow a front-end origin through CORS.
days.deliverable: Upload and download endpoints and CORS configuration
checks: Upload a text file renamed to .png

days.topic: Scheduling and Asynchronous Tasks
subtopics: Fixed rate, fixed delay and cron
Avoiding duplicate runs on several instances
days.lab_task: Add a nightly job that marks overdue loans and an async email sender, configure a bounded thread pool and use ShedLock so the job runs once across two instances.
days.deliverable: Scheduled job, async service and ShedLock configuration

days.topic: Packaging and Running Spring Boot in Docker
subtopics: Writing a Dockerfile for Spring Boot
days.lab_task: Build the catalogue as a container image twice (a layered Dockerfile and Buildpacks), run it with PostgreSQL in Docker Compose with configuration from environment variables and compare image size and startup time.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, compose file and comparison table
checks: Change only application code and rebuild
Size and startup time recorded for both

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Library Lending REST API
days.lab_task: Build a library lending API with books, members and loans: Flyway migrations, validated DTOs, role-based security, paged search, an overdue job, OpenAPI docs, tests and Docker Compose, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, OpenAPI spec, test report and demo recording
checks: Whole system runs from one command
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one service

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built Spring Boot REST services. Covers how auto-configuration works, JPA performance, caching, token-based security and OAuth2, messaging with Kafka and RabbitMQ, Testcontainers, API design, reactive endpoints, Spring Batch, observability, resilience, Spring Cloud, MongoDB, events and the outbox pattern, CI and running on Kubernetes.
prerequisites: Has built a Spring Boot REST API with Spring Data JPA
Writes tests with JUnit and MockMvc
outcomes: Build secure, observable Spring Boot microservices that communicate through APIs and messages
Test against real infrastructure with Testcontainers
Build and run services in CI and on Kubernetes

days.topic: How Auto-Configuration Works and Custom Starters
subtopics: The conditions evaluation report in depth
days.lab_task: Build an internal audit starter that auto-configures an audit logger when a property is set, backs off when the user defines their own bean and ships configuration metadata, then test each condition.
days.deliverable: Starter module, metadata and tests
checks: Add the starter with the property on
Type the property in the IDE

days.topic: JPA Performance: Fetching, N+1 and Batching
subtopics: Measuring queries with logs and statistics
days.lab_task: Find and fix N+1 queries in an order listing, switch to a DTO projection, enable batch inserts for an import and add optimistic locking to stock updates, recording query counts before and after.
days.deliverable: Query counts before and after, code changes and a locking test
checks: Query count drops from over 100 to under 5
Update the same product twice concurrently
One update fails with an optimistic lock error

days.topic: Caching with Spring Cache and Redis
days.lab_task: Cache product lookups in Redis with a 10-minute TTL, evict on update, prevent caching of null results and measure hit rate and latency under a load test.
days.deliverable: Cache configuration, eviction tests and hit-rate metrics
checks: Next read returns the new value

days.topic: JWT Authentication and Method Security
days.lab_task: Add a login endpoint that issues short-lived JWTs and refresh tokens, protect services with @PreAuthorize including an "only the owner can read their order" rule and test with @WithMockUser and real tokens.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, token endpoints and tests

days.topic: OAuth2 Login and Resource Servers
subtopics: Spring Boot as a resource server
Mapping scopes and roles from tokens
Keycloak or Entra ID as the identity provider
days.lab_task: Run Keycloak in Docker, configure the order service as a resource server mapping realm roles, call it from a second service with client credentials and test with mock JWTs.
days.deliverable: Keycloak realm export, resource server configuration and tests
checks: Call with a token missing the scope
Role mapping verified with mock JWTs

days.topic: Messaging with Spring for Apache Kafka
subtopics: Testing with embedded Kafka or Testcontainers
days.lab_task: Publish an OrderPlaced event from the order service, consume it in an inventory service, route poison messages to a dead-letter topic and make the consumer idempotent.
days.deliverable: Producer, consumer, error handling and tests
checks: Message lands on the dead-letter topic

days.topic: RabbitMQ with Spring AMQP
subtopics: When to choose RabbitMQ or Kafka
days.lab_task: Send order confirmation emails through a RabbitMQ topic exchange, retry failed sends three times with back-off, then route them to a dead-letter queue and inspect it in the management UI.
days.deliverable: AMQP configuration, listener and management UI screenshot
checks: Two cases each for RabbitMQ and Kafka

days.topic: Integration Testing with Testcontainers
days.lab_task: Write integration tests for placing an order that run against real PostgreSQL, Kafka and Redis containers using @ServiceConnection, and run the app locally with the same containers.
days.deliverable: Integration tests and local run configuration
checks: Tests pass on the CI runner

days.topic: API Design: Versioning, Contracts and Idempotency
subtopics: Consumer-driven contracts with Spring Cloud Contract
days.lab_task: Design version 2 of the order API contract-first, generate server interfaces, add idempotency keys to order creation and write a consumer contract that the provider verifies.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI spec, generated interfaces, contract tests and changelog
checks: Repeat a POST with the same idempotency key
Break the contract on the provider

days.topic: Reactive Endpoints with Spring WebFlux
days.lab_task: Build a price streaming endpoint with server-sent events that combines two upstream services through WebClient, store prices with R2DBC and test it with StepVerifier.
days.deliverable: Reactive service, tests and a note on when to use it
checks: Open the stream in a browser
Clear cases for and against WebFlux

days.topic: Batch Processing with Spring Batch
days.lab_task: Build a job that imports a 100,000-line product CSV in chunks, skips bad rows into an error file, restarts from the failed chunk after a crash and runs partitioned across four threads.
days.deliverable: Job configuration, error file and run history
checks: Kill the job halfway and restart
Resumes from the last committed chunk
Ten rows in the error file and the rest imported

days.topic: Observability with Micrometer Tracing and Prometheus
days.lab_task: Add tracing to the order and inventory services, export traces to Jaeger and metrics to Prometheus, build a Grafana dashboard for request rate, errors and latency and find a slow call through its trace.
days.deliverable: Configuration, dashboard and a trace screenshot
checks: No user IDs or other high-cardinality labels

days.topic: Resilience in Spring Boot Services
days.lab_task: Protect the order service's call to payments with a timeout, retries, a circuit breaker and a fallback, then show the breaker opening and closing under simulated failures.
days.deliverable: Resilience configuration, tests and breaker state metrics
checks: Circuit opens and calls fail fast
Calls fail at the timeout instead of hanging

days.topic: Spring Cloud Config and Service Discovery
subtopics: Discovery on Kubernetes instead of Eureka
When to use none of these
days.lab_task: Run a config server backed by a Git repository, move service settings into it, refresh a value without a restart and register two inventory instances with Eureka for load-balanced calls.
days.deliverable: Config repository, server configuration and load-balancing logs

days.topic: API Gateway with Spring Cloud Gateway
days.lab_task: Put a gateway in front of the services with routes per service, token validation, per-client rate limits and correlation ID propagation.
days.deliverable: Gateway configuration and test results

days.topic: Document Data with Spring Data MongoDB
days.lab_task: Store product reviews in MongoDB with embedded replies, add indexes for product and rating, build an aggregation for average rating per product and test it against a container.
days.deliverable: Document model, repository, aggregation and tests

days.topic: Domain Events and the Transactional Outbox
days.lab_task: Replace direct Kafka publishing in the order service with an outbox table written in the same transaction, publish it with a poller and with Debezium, and prove no event is lost when Kafka is down.
days.deliverable: Outbox table, publishers and failure test

days.topic: CI Pipelines for Spring Boot Services
subtopics: Unit, slice and integration test stages
Static analysis with SpotBugs or SonarQube
days.lab_task: Build a GitHub Actions pipeline for the order service that caches dependencies, runs all test stages with Testcontainers, scans dependencies and the image, and pushes a versioned image only when quality gates pass.
days.deliverable: Workflow file and a green pipeline run
checks: Pipeline stops before the image push
Compare run times with and without the cache

days.topic: Running Spring Boot on Kubernetes
subtopics: Deployments and services for Spring Boot
Liveness and readiness probes from Actuator
Resource requests and JVM memory settings
days.lab_task: Deploy the services to a local Kubernetes cluster with Actuator probes, configuration from ConfigMaps and Secrets, correct memory limits, graceful shutdown and an autoscaler, then roll out a new version without errors.
days.deliverable: Kubernetes manifests or Helm chart and rollout evidence
checks: Roll out a new version under load
Readiness fails and traffic stops to the pod
JVM heap fits inside the container limit

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Event-Driven Order Platform
days.lab_task: Build an order platform with gateway, order, inventory and payment services using OAuth2, Kafka with an outbox, resilience, tracing and Testcontainers tests, deployed to Kubernetes through CI, then demo a failure and recovery.
days.deliverable: Repositories, pipeline, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Place an order end to end
Orders queue and complete when it returns
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior developers and architects running Spring Boot in production. Covers performance tuning, virtual threads, native images, multi-tenancy, authorisation servers, sagas, event sourcing, modular monoliths, database scaling, Kafka Streams, zero-downtime releases, cloud platforms, SLOs, supply-chain security, chaos testing, Spring AI, GraphQL, upgrades and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has built and run Spring Boot microservices in production
Knows Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes at a working level
Understands JPA performance and Spring Security configuration
outcomes: Design and tune Spring Boot systems for performance, scale and reliability
Choose between microservices, modular monoliths, sagas and event sourcing
Release safely and secure the software supply chain
Diagnose and fix production problems quickly

days.topic: Spring Boot Performance Tuning and Profiling
subtopics: Load testing with Gatling or k6
Thread pool and connection pool sizing
days.lab_task: Load test the order service to its limit, profile it with JFR and async-profiler, fix the two largest hotspots and the pool sizes, and show the improvement under the same load.
days.deliverable: Load test reports before and after, flame graphs and change notes
checks: Lower after the changes at the same load
Top hotspot identified with its cause

days.topic: Virtual Threads and Concurrency in Spring Boot
subtopics: Enabling virtual threads in Spring Boot
Pinning and how to find it
Connection pools as the real limit
days.lab_task: Run the same blocking service with platform threads, virtual threads and WebFlux, find and remove a pinning case and compare throughput and memory under load.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results, pinning fix and recommendation
checks: JFR shows the pinned thread event before the fix
Results recorded for all three models
Clear rule for when to use each model

days.topic: Native Images with GraalVM and Spring AOT
subtopics: Class Data Sharing and CRaC as alternatives
days.lab_task: Build the inventory service as a native image, fix a missing reflection hint, run the tests in native mode and compare startup, memory and peak throughput with the JVM version.
days.deliverable: Native image build, hints and comparison table
objectives: Decide when native is worth it

days.topic: Multi-Tenancy in Spring Boot Applications
subtopics: Tenancy models: shared schema, schema per tenant, database per tenant
Resolving the tenant from the request
days.lab_task: Make the order service multi-tenant with schema per tenant, resolve the tenant from the token, migrate all tenant schemas with Flyway and prove one tenant cannot read another's data.
days.deliverable: Tenancy implementation, migration process and isolation tests
checks: Tenant ID included in every key

days.topic: Advanced Spring Security: Authorization Server and Fine-Grained Access
subtopics: Securing Kafka consumers and internal calls
days.lab_task: Run Spring Authorization Server with custom claims, enforce a rule that managers can approve refunds only under a limit through an authorisation manager and OPA, and audit every decision.
days.deliverable: Authorization server, policy and audit log
checks: Approve a refund above the limit

days.topic: Sagas and Distributed Transactions
subtopics: Tools: Temporal, Axon and hand-written orchestrators
days.lab_task: Implement order placement as an orchestrated saga across inventory and payment with compensations, then run it as a choreography and compare failure handling.
days.deliverable: Two saga implementations, failure tests and comparison
checks: Fail payment after stock is reserved
Saga ends in a clear failed state

days.topic: Event Sourcing and CQRS with Spring
subtopics: Events as the source of truth
When not to use event sourcing
tools: Axon Framework or a custom event store
days.lab_task: Event-source the account balance of a wallet service, build two read models with projections, add snapshots and rebuild a read model from scratch.
days.deliverable: Event store, projections and rebuild evidence

days.topic: Modular Monoliths with Spring Modulith
subtopics: Extracting a module into a service later
days.lab_task: Restructure a tangled monolith into orders, inventory and billing modules, verify boundaries in a test, switch cross-module calls to events and generate module documentation.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, verification test and module diagrams
checks: Steps to move billing to a service

days.topic: Database Scaling: Pools, Read Replicas and Partitioning
subtopics: Read replicas with routing data sources
Database connection limits across many pods
days.lab_task: Route read-only transactions to a replica, add pgbouncer in front of PostgreSQL for 30 pods, partition the orders table by month and measure the hot query before and after.
days.deliverable: Routing configuration, partition migrations and measurements
checks: Connections stay under the database limit

days.topic: Stream Processing with Kafka Streams and Spring
days.lab_task: Build a stream that counts orders per product in five-minute windows, joins with product data, exposes results through an interactive query endpoint and is tested with TopologyTestDriver.
days.deliverable: Topology, query endpoint and tests

days.topic: Zero-Downtime Releases and Database Changes
days.lab_task: Rename a column used by a live service with expand and contract migrations over three releases, roll out with a canary and automatic analysis, and roll back a bad version.
days.deliverable: Migration sequence, rollout configuration and rollback evidence
checks: Run the three releases under load
Release a version with high errors
Old and new code work at every step

days.topic: Spring Boot on AWS and Azure
subtopics: Managed options: EKS, ECS, App Runner, Azure Container Apps, AKS
Spring Cloud AWS and Spring Cloud Azure
Messaging with SQS, SNS and Service Bus
days.lab_task: Deploy the inventory service to AWS ECS with RDS and Secrets Manager and to Azure Container Apps with Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Key Vault, using workload identity and no stored keys, and compare cost and effort.
days.deliverable: Terraform for both, running services and comparison
checks: Monthly cost and effort estimated for both
objectives: Run Spring Boot on cloud platforms

days.topic: Production Observability: SLOs, Dashboards and Alerting
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for the order API, build burn-rate alerts and a dashboard with exemplars, write a runbook and trigger the alert with an injected failure.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, alerts, dashboard and runbook
checks: Issue found and fixed in under 15 minutes

days.topic: Securing the Software Supply Chain for Spring Boot
subtopics: Keeping dependencies current with Renovate or Dependabot
Security headers and OWASP Top 10 checks
days.lab_task: Generate an SBOM for the service, triage its vulnerabilities, sign and verify the image in CI, enable automatic dependency updates and run a ZAP baseline scan.
days.deliverable: SBOM, triage notes, signed image and scan report
checks: Each high finding fixed or justified

days.topic: Chaos Testing and Failure Injection
days.lab_task: Run a game day on the order platform: inject latency, kill pods and drop the database connection, check each steady-state hypothesis and fix the weakest point found.
days.deliverable: Experiment plan, results and fix
checks: Inject 2 seconds of latency into payments
Orders still accepted within the SLO
Error rate stays under the budget

days.topic: AI Features with Spring AI
days.lab_task: Add a product question-answering endpoint that retrieves product documents from pgvector, answers with citations and returns structured output, with a fallback when the model is unavailable and an evaluation set of 20 questions.
days.deliverable: AI endpoint, evaluation results and cost estimate
checks: Ask a question from the evaluation set
objectives: Build AI features with Spring AI

days.topic: GraphQL APIs with Spring for GraphQL
days.lab_task: Expose orders, products and customers through GraphQL with batch loading, cursor pagination, field-level security and a complexity limit, and test it with GraphQlTester.
days.deliverable: Schema, controllers and tests
checks: Request a restricted field as a normal user

days.topic: Upgrading and Migrating Spring Boot Versions
subtopics: Reading release notes and migration guides
Dependency management with the Boot BOM
days.lab_task: Upgrade a legacy service from Spring Boot 2.7 to the current version with OpenRewrite and the properties migrator, fix the remaining issues by hand and write an upgrade playbook for other teams.
days.deliverable: Upgraded service, change list and playbook
checks: Run the tests after the upgrade

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Spring Boot Issues
subtopics: Reading logs, metrics and traces together
days.lab_task: Diagnose four injected production problems (a deadlock, a memory leak, pool exhaustion and a slow query) using only production-safe tools, fix each and write a post-incident review for one.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Threads and locks named from the thread dump
Leaking object identified in the heap dump

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Production-Ready Spring Boot Platform
days.lab_task: Take the order platform to production standard: choose and justify the architecture, meet a latency SLO under load, add multi-tenancy, sign images, release with canaries, run a chaos game day and present the result to an architecture review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture decision records, load and chaos results, release evidence and review presentation
checks: SLO met at the target load
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Run Spring Boot at production standard
